g.title: crate Validate user WGSL and assemble Kivact shader modules.
crate::assemble Assembles the complete shader module of a user source in two parses.
crate::entry The entry point and `Params` declaration read from a user source.
crate::error The error of a user shader source, with its position in that source.
crate::hash The FNV-1a 64-bit hash that identifies an assembled module.
crate::layout The byte layout of the `Params` uniform block.
crate::prelude The fixed WGSL text that surrounds a user shader in an assembled module.
crate::source Lexical checks of a user's shader source, and the offset map back to it.
